action_items: No backend test file was added for this iteration: theme and greeting are entirely client-side (localStorage/device time), with no API-bearing behavior to cover per the backend-test rule.

checks.criterion: Dashboard greeting follows the user's local time boundaries
checks.name: dashboard-greeting-time-boundaries
checks.evidence: Mocked clock to 09:00/14:00/19:00/02:00 across reloads on the authenticated Dashboard; dashboard-eyebrow showed 'Good Morning, reviewer', 'Good Afternoon', 'Good Evening', and 'Good Evening' respectively.

checks.criterion: Greeting updates automatically without a page refresh
checks.name: dashboard-greeting-auto-updates
checks.evidence: With clock installed at 11:59:30, dashboard-eyebrow read 'Good Morning'; advancing the clock past 12:00 and running timers (no navigation) flipped it to 'Good Afternoon'; a synthetic visibilitychange event at 18:00 flipped it to 'Good Evening'.

checks.criterion: First visit theme follows device preference
checks.name: theme-first-visit-device-preference
checks.evidence: With package_compliance_checker_theme cleared, emulateMedia(dark) produced <html class="dark"> on reload; emulateMedia(light) produced <html> without the dark class.

checks.criterion: Header theme toggle switches and persists theme
checks.name: header-theme-toggle-persists
checks.evidence: Clicking header-theme-toggle toggled html.dark, flipped aria-label between 'Switch to dark mode'/'Switch to light mode', wrote 'dark'/'light' to localStorage[package_compliance_checker_theme], and both states survived page reload.

checks.criterion: Settings theme control stays synchronized with the header
checks.name: settings-theme-synced-with-header
checks.evidence: settings-theme-toggle showed 'Dark mode' while light was active; clicking it applied html.dark and relabeled to 'Light mode'; header-theme-toggle on the same and a subsequently navigated Dashboard page reflected the identical dark state.

checks.criterion: Light and dark themes remain readable across the existing app
checks.name: dark-theme-readability-across-app
checks.evidence: In dark mode, Dashboard metrics/trend/violation cards, recent-analyses table, Results, and Settings inputs all rendered with dark (non-white, rgb non 255,255,255) card backgrounds and legible light text; screenshots captured for each page.

checks.criterion: Theme controls remain usable on mobile
checks.name: theme-toggle-mobile-usable
checks.evidence: At 390x844, header-theme-toggle was visible and toggled html.dark; document.scrollWidth <= clientWidth in both dark and light (no horizontal overflow); mobile-menu-button opened the sidebar showing the Settings link over the dark surface.
